acquisition: Stanford Interlibrary Loan request 446829, delivered by UC Berkeley as a web scan
bibliography: Buddruss, Georg. 1992. Waigali-Sprichwörter. Studien zur Indologie und Iranistik 16/17:65–80.

extraction.method: complete record-by-record manual collation against 400 dpi page renders
ocr_reproducibility: embedded PDF text layer used for navigation

rights: Copyrighted ILL scan supplied for private study, scholarship, or research; the scan is not checked in.

scope.cdial_policy: direct unambiguous Turner/CDIAL assignments are linked; hedged, alternative, and secondary comparisons remain prose
scope.excluded: the 25 proverb texts and their running translations; inflected examples not promoted by Buddruss to headword status; comparative Kamviri, Wamai, Tregami, Pashai, and other-language forms in etymological commentary
scope.included: every printed headword and explicit headword alternate in the complete glossary on pp. 71–78
scope.language_model: all forms belong to canonical Waigali (Wg) and carry the registered Nisheigram dialect tag (nis); informants remain provenance
